speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is in. Eight-and-twenty shillings. Monday was the Queen's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight-and-twenty. Say it once. I will not have it again at supper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then once. I am not making it a total for the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is the reckoning. It is not the coffer. The book is shut on the sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut, then. I am not carrying the figure in my mouth.
